channel.title: FRB: Press Releases
channel.description: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System press releases

item.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
item.description: Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace. The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

item.title: Speech by Governor Adams on the economic outlook and monetary policy
item.description: At the Economic Club of Chicago, Chicago, Illinois — remarks as prepared for delivery.

item.title: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement action
item.description: The Federal Reserve Board on Monday announced the termination of an enforcement action.

item.title: Federal Reserve Board releases results of annual bank stress test
item.description: The results show that large banks are well positioned to weather a severe recession.
